identity.name: RM 035 Rafael Nadal
identity.one_liner: A daily-wear complement to the ultralight RM 027 tourbillon Nadal wore in competition, built to Richard Mille's Chronofiable durability certification.

narrative.story: The RM 035 arrived in 2011 as part of Richard Mille's expanding Rafael Nadal line, positioned as a more wearable everyday counterpart to the extreme, ultralight RM 027 tourbillon Nadal wore during matches. It was the first Richard Mille model to carry the brand's Chronofiable certification, a durability standard developed to validate the watch under the shocks and torque of competitive tennis rather than typical wear.
narrative.collector_notes: Later automatic variants, including the RM 35-03 with a butterfly rotor, are mechanically distinct from the original manual-wind RM 035; collectors match caliber and case reference together rather than assuming continuity across the Nadal RM 035 lineage.
